note: 5 sets x 2000 prompts = 10000. Each set is 1600 adversarial prompts + 400 benign controls. Every prompt is unique across the whole suite. Attacks are generated as frames x targets x pressure modifiers, so the corpus is reproducible from the pools in build_suite.py.
honesty: These 10,000 prompts densely sample FIVE attack families -- they are not 10,000 unrelated ideas. The model is evaluated at temperature 0 and is therefore deterministic, so only distinct prompts carry information; repeats would carry none. Moving from 500 to 10,000 narrows the confidence interval on the refusal rate from roughly +/-2% to +/-0.5%. It does not say anything about attack shapes that are absent from these five families.
